full_prompt_en: A square oil-painted landscape presents a compact village gathered around a gray stone church amid densely patterned green hills. The view looks downward across an intricate patchwork of sloping fields, narrow paths, cottages, gardens, and closely packed trees. In the upper distance, yellow-green farmland curves around a dark hedgerow, while small red and pale roofs peek through deep blue-green foliage. Near the center, the church tower rises above surrounding houses, its arched openings and stone courses picked out in pale gray and muted lavender. The broad church roof angles down toward the lower left, and neighboring white walls and warm brick roofs break up the green masses around it. On the left side, smaller houses step down the hillside; on the right, a narrow lane and a modest white building are partially enclosed by rounded shrubs. Across the foreground, large dark green bushes and a sliver of yellow field form a substantial base to the crowded upper scene. Almost every surface is assembled from short, firm strokes or tiny dabs of color. The fields carry parallel marks that follow their contours, the trees are built from dense flecks of green and blue, and the masonry has a dry granular weave rather than a smooth finish. Outlines are present through changes of value and color, yet the many touches remain visibly separate, giving the landscape a vibrating decorative surface. Bright daylight strikes the open fields and pale stone, while dark blue-green hollows beneath the trees lend depth to the slopes. The overall composition is full but readable, using a high viewpoint and repeated small marks to turn the village into a lively mosaic of greens, warm roofs, and cool stone.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形油画风景，紧凑的村庄围绕一座灰石教堂聚集，四周是布满纹样的绿丘。视角向下俯瞰由坡地、窄路、村舍、花园和密集树木交织的复杂拼图。上方远处，黄绿色农田沿着深色篱树弯曲，小片红色与浅色屋顶从深蓝绿色枝叶间露出。画面中央附近，教堂塔楼高过周围房屋，拱形开口与石块砌缝以浅灰和低调紫色点出。宽阔的教堂屋顶斜向左下，相邻的白墙与暖砖红屋顶打断周围的绿色团块。左侧，较小的房屋沿山坡层层降低；右侧，一条窄巷和一座朴素白色小屋部分被圆润灌木围住。前景大片深绿色树丛与一小块黄色田地，为上方拥挤的场景形成厚实底座。几乎每个表面都由短促坚实的笔触或细小点涂拼成。田地的平行笔痕顺着地形走向，树木由密集绿蓝色碎点构成，石砌墙面具有干涩颗粒编织感，而非光滑表面。轮廓通过明度和色彩变化显现，但许多色点仍各自可辨，使风景表面产生微微振动的装饰效果。明亮日光照在开阔田地和浅色石墙上，树下的深蓝绿色凹处则为山坡带来纵深。整体构图繁密而可读，以高视点和重复的小笔触将村庄化成绿色、暖色屋顶与冷调石材的鲜活马赛克。
style_prompt_en: The painted surface is constructed from short, closely packed strokes and small dabs of oil color, creating a granular, gently vibrating texture. Interlocking green, yellow-green, blue-green, warm brick red, cream, and cool gray areas make a dense but legible color mosaic. Rounded masses repeat at different scales, while slanted bands and compact angular shapes direct the eye through the frame. Edges emerge from adjacent shifts in hue and value rather than continuous hard contour lines; individual marks remain visible inside the larger forms. Clear daylight brightens upper planes, with saturated blue-green darks collecting in recessed areas and between overlapping masses. The space feels deep through stepped planes and a high viewpoint, yet its tight patterning keeps the surface strongly decorative. The effect is lively, orderly, and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画表面由短而密的笔触及细小油彩点涂构成，形成颗粒状、轻微振动的肌理。交锁的绿、黄绿、蓝绿、暖砖红、奶油色和冷灰色块组成繁密却清晰的色彩马赛克。圆润团块以不同尺度重复，斜向色带和紧凑的折角形体引导视线穿过画面。边缘由相邻色相与明度的变化显出，而非连续硬轮廓线；单独笔痕在较大的形体内依然可见。清亮日光提亮朝上的平面，饱和蓝绿色暗部聚在凹处与重叠形体之间。层层退远的平面和高视点使空间具有纵深，而紧密的纹样又保持强烈装饰性。效果活泼、有序且富于触感。
theme_en: A clustered village around a stone church in green hills
theme_zh: 绿丘中围绕石砌教堂的村庄
name: Charles Ginner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
